import sys, json, random, subprocess, os
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
from t_common import *
from t_naive import naive_image
import scamp_pipeline as sp

def run(lines):
    p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=''.join(l+'\n' for l in lines),
                       text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=900)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[:2000]
    out=p.stdout.split(b'\n'); assert out[-1]==b''; out=out[:-1]
    assert len(out)==len(lines)
    return [json.loads(x) for x in out]

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 555)
lines=[]; meta=[]
for t in range(120):
    n = rng.randint(0,10)
    fib = gen_fib(rng, n, rng.choice(['mixed','short','long','aligned']))
    S = rng.randint(4,16); ms = rng.randint(4,32)
    if S*ms < 128: continue
    cuts = gen_cuts(rng,S,ms)
    caps = [rng.choice([1,64,128,192,256,512,1024,4096,10**6,10**9]) for _ in range(S)]
    img = naive_image(fib, caps, ms, cuts)
    addrs = [sp.canon_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,6))]
    for (a,l,h) in fib[:3]:
        addrs.append(sp.canon_addr(a | (rng.getrandbits(128) & sp.HMASK[l])))
    lines.append(json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs},separators=(',',':')))
    meta.append((fib,caps,addrs,img))
res = run(lines)
nacc=nrej=0
for (fib,caps,addrs,img), r in zip(meta,res):
    feasible = all(u<=c for u,c in zip(img['used_bits'],caps))
    if feasible:
        nacc+=1
        assert r['status']=='ok', ('false rejection!', json.dumps(img)[:600], r)
        assert len(r['answers'])==len(addrs)
        for s,a in zip(addrs, r['answers']):
            av=sp.parse_ipv6(s); best=None
            for (pa,pl,ph) in fib:
                if (av & sp.TMASK[pl])==pa and (best is None or pl>best[1]): best=(ph,pl)
            exp={'hop':None,'prefix_length':None} if best is None else {'hop':best[0],'prefix_length':best[1]}
            assert a==exp, (s,a,exp,fib)
    else:
        nrej+=1
        assert r['status']=='invalid', ('accepted infeasible image', json.dumps(img)[:600], r)
print('accepted',nacc,'rejected(infeasible)',nrej)
print('VALIDIMG OK')
EOF
